description: Step 1 of opening a task as a verified job: validates the task against its policy and returns the unsigned createJob transaction for the user's own wallet (the client) to sign and send on Base Mainnet. Read the jobId from the JobCreated event of its receipt, then call arl_prepare_funding.

client.description: The user's wallet: it signs and pays

committee.description: Staked validators, as many as the task's committee_size

policy.description: The arl-policy/1 document the task names; omit for a built-in policy

provider.description: The agent or service doing the work

taskUri.description: https or ipfs URI where validators fetch the task document

name: arl_prepare_job
